models.notes: Cheap, fast, the default volume player. Its transport differs from the rest of its own provider, which is why the block above exists: contract, pinned client version and components used to live in a model switch in fleet.mjs, an if-chain in run.sh and a pair of z.literal schemas in fleet_attestation.ts, and drifting between those three was a matter of time.

Calibration instrument. No requiredCliVersion: the strict-code-mode transport is not version-sensitive the way the direct-MCP ones are, and inventing a pin to fill the field would be the lie the registry exists to stop.

The default codex blind player (no --model needed). Runs the strict-code-mode-v2 lane at reasoning effort max; the 0.151.0 models catalog advertises low/medium/high/xhigh/max for this id. context_window pins the model's advertised 872k maximum (verified live: the launch override yields an 828,400-token effective window) because max-effort playthroughs measured ~155 gameplay calls fill the 272k default and die at the deliberate no-compaction rule. Fleet cohorts pin their own effort explicitly and are unaffected by this default.
